title: rosa × provincialis var. centifolia
intro: Rosa × provincialis var. centifolia, commonly known as Rose de Mai or the May Rose, is a variant of the rose species that is native to Southern Europe. This plant is valued for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rosa × provincialis var. centifolia include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce stress, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been shown to exhibit anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties.
